engine_requirements: Small change to the grants_gov parse (adapters/api.ts, grants_gov block near line 61). Today parseDate(o.closeDate) passes Grants.gov sentinel closeDates through as real deadlines: NSF uses 10/0x/2076 for rolling calls (26-518 is 10/05/2076). Required rule: if the closeDate year is >= 2070, set deadline null and keep status open. Status cannot be 'rolling': the DB CHECK and types.ts allow only forecasted, open, closed, archived. Request: POST https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2 with JSON {oppNum, agencies:'NSF', oppStatuses:'forecasted|posted', rows:5}; use data.oppHits[0]; map number to external_id, title, id to url https://www.grants.gov/search-results-detail/<id>, closeDate to deadline with the sentinel rule. No headers, no cookies, no pagination.

summary: The TRDF NSF-BSF hub is server-rendered and plain-HTTP reachable. It lists NSF solicitations open to Israeli co-PIs, and each is live on Grants.gov under its own opportunity number. The existing grants_gov adapter returns real titles for them, but Grants.gov encodes rolling calls with a 2076 closeDate, which the engine would show as a real deadline. The fix is a small sentinel rule in the grants_gov parse, plus one row per NSF solicitation.
evidence: TRDF hub: 'NSF 26-518 ... Proposals are accepted anytime.' and 'NSF 26-517 ... Proposals are accepted anytime.'

Grants.gov search2 oppNum 26-518: closeDate 10/05/2076, oppStatus posted, id 363616. Other NSF rolling calls also carry 2076 closeDates (26-522 10/07/2076, 26-520 10/08/2076, 26-517 10/05/2076, 26-523 10/06/2076, 26-515 11/04/2076).
Grants.gov closeDate for 26-522 is 10/07/2076, while the TRDF hub says its next target date is 2026-11-16. The 2076 value is a sentinel, not a deadline.

issues: Deadline sentinel: closeDate 2076 passes through as a real deadline in the current engine. Needs the parse rule in engine_requirements before the row is shown to users.
Coverage: one row covers one solicitation. The hub lists about 10 NSF calls; each needs its own row, or an engine loop over oppNums.
Renumbering or closure: if NSF renumbers or closes a solicitation, the row silently returns zero hits. Log zero-hit rows as a warning.
BSF's own page is behind Cloudflare and cannot be read by the edge function.
The NSF public API for opportunities returns 404 from the gateway; do not propose it.
prototype_summary: Node, plain fetch to api.grants.gov search2 with oppNum; sentinel year >= 2070 gives deadline null; status open; url from id.
